subject: PO and billing: net terms, invoice cadence, PO field mapping (ClearPeak Health)
messages:
From: Emily Norton <emily.norton@clearpeakhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Fischer <markus.fischer@scprocure.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements, billing cadence, and net terms for Redwood contract

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the recent demo — the product looks promising. Procurement has a handful of mandatory requirements before Legal will sign:

- Net terms: our standard is Net 60 for SaaS vendors (we will not accept Net 30 unless escalated).
- Invoice cadence: we prefer monthly consolidated invoices to the parent entity; however, each BU requires its own PO number to appear either on the invoice header or per-line so our ERP can split costs.
- PO format: our template requires a PO number, billing address, GL code per line item, and a "Bill to entity" field.
- Cutoff: invoices must be received by the 5th business day after period close for processing in that calendar month.

I've attached our PO template (CPH_PO_Template.pdf) and an example GL mapping file. Can Redwood accept Net 60 with these invoice requirements, or do you require different cadence to maintain pricing? If pricing would change with Net 60, please outline options (early-pay discount, quarterly invoicing, credit offsets).

We need a proposed approach this week so Finance & Legal can review. Also please include a sample invoice that shows the PO field placement.

Thanks,
Emily Norton
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearPeak Health

--
Attachments: CPH_PO_Template.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Norton <emily.norton@clearpeakhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO requirements, billing cadence, and net terms for Redwood contract

Hi Emily — appreciate the clear list and the template. Quick summary of what Redwood can and cannot support out of the box, plus three commercially realistic options to get this across the finish line:

Our default: Net 30, monthly invoice at standard list pricing. We do support PO number in the invoice header and can include line-item fields for BU PO/GL codes.

Option A — Accept Net 60, maintain current price: requires either (i) a 12‑month commitment (annual contract) or (ii) a one-time onboarding credit to offset cashflow. We can hold price if ClearPeak signs an annual commitment within 30 days.

Option B — Accept Net 60 with a small premium: +2.5% on recurring spend (applied as a billing modifier) to cover extended receivables. This requires no term commitment.

Option C — Keep pricing, move to quarterly consolidated invoices to reduce our AR exposure (we'd bill on a quarter-in-arrear cycle, but remove the Net 60 requirement).

Operational notes:
- We can place the ClearPeak BU PO on the invoice header and also echo it at line-item level for ERP matching.
- Invoice cutoff: we can commit to your \"received by the 5th business day\" rule if invoices are issued by Redwood no later than the 2nd business day after period close. If you require later issuance, that pushes invoice recognition into the following month which affects billing cycles.
- Tax/VAT: please confirm tax IDs per entity so we populate correctly.

I've attached: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (shows exact header fields we populate) and Sample_Invoice_CPH.pdf (mock invoice showing PO in header + GL column).

Ben (AE) and Grace (CS) are looped in to confirm SOW/onboarding timelines and whether ClearPeak wants a consolidated parent invoice with BU PO references or separate invoices per BU.

If you can confirm which option your procurement committee prefers, we will prepare the SOW + payment addendum for legal.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf; Sample_Invoice_CPH.pdf
From: Emily Norton <emily.norton@clearpeakhealth.com>

Cc: Markus Fischer <markus.fischer@scprocure.com>, Legal Team <legal@clearpeakhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO requirements, billing cadence, and net terms for Redwood contract

Hi Vivek,

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from Procurement & Finance after they reviewed your sample invoice and instructions:

1) Our budget committee is firm on Net 60 and will not accept a price uplift as part of standard procurement policy. The only commercial lever they will consider is a longer commitment (12 months) in exchange for holding price.
2) Quarterly invoices are a possibility, but the business prefers monthly allocations for internal chargebacks. If you can issue a consolidated monthly invoice to the parent and include BU-level PO numbers on each line item, that meets our ERP needs.
3) The onboarding credit sounds promising. If Redwood will (a) hold price for 12 months and (b) provide a one-time onboarding credit applied in month 1 to offset cashflow, Procurement is likely to greenlight.

Please send the SOW and a draft payment addendum that includes Net 60 language and the credit mechanics so our Legal team can review. Also confirm DocuSign readiness — we push everything through our e-sign gateway.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Emily
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearPeak Health

--

Hi Emily — great to be moving forward. Confirming commercial position and next steps:

1) Commercial: Redwood will hold existing pricing for 12 months if ClearPeak signs a 12‑month commitment. In addition, we can offer a one-time onboarding credit of USD 25,000 applied to your first invoice to ease cashflow during the initial months (this satisfies the "credit offset" discussed).

2) Net terms: We will accept Net 60 as requested provided the 12‑month commitment is executed. We will not apply a recurring premium in this case.

3) Invoice cadence & PO fields: We will issue consolidated monthly invoices to the parent entity and include BU PO numbers at the line level for ERP matching. Please confirm the exact PO field name you prefer ("BU PO", "Project PO", or "ERP PO").

4) Docs: Attached are the updated SOW (SOW_Redwood_v2.pdf) and a draft payment addendum that captures Net 60 and credit mechanics (payment_addendum_draft.docx). We can route both via DocuSign once legal has signed off.
